items.title: File Klage against the use-prohibition order (Nutzungsuntersagung)
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid kann innerhalb eines Monats nach seiner Bekanntgabe Klage beim Verwaltungsgericht Musterarnsberg, Jägerstraße 1, 59821 Musterarnsberg, erhoben werden; ein Widerspruchsverfahren findet nicht statt.
items.computation: The letter is internally inconsistent about its own date: the body text refers to 'diesem Bescheid vom 18.11.2026' while the letterhead 'Datum' field shows 20.11.2026. Taking the earlier, safer reading (Bescheid date 18.11.2026, a Wednesday) as the posting day: an authority letter sent by ordinary post counts as delivered (Bekanntgabe) on the 4th day after posting under § 41 Abs. 2 VwVfG, i.e. Sunday 22.11.2026 (for this type of letter this day does not shift for falling on a weekend). Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of delivery is not counted, so the one-month period (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB) runs from 23.11.2026 and ends on the day of the following month bearing the same number as the delivery day, i.e. Tuesday 22.12.2026. That day is a normal working day in NRW (not a Sunday, Saturday or public holiday), so no further shift applies under § 31 Abs. 3 VwVfG / § 57 Abs. 2 VwGO. If instead the letterhead date of 20.11.2026 is the true posting day, the same chain gives Thursday 24.12.2026 — four days later. The earlier date (22.12.2026) is used here for safety.

warnings: The letter contradicts itself on its own date: the body text says the Bescheid is 'vom 18.11.2026' while the letterhead 'Datum' field says 20.11.2026; this shifts the one-month Klage deadline by several days (22.12.2026 vs. 24.12.2026) — the earlier date was used and confidence lowered accordingly.

The letterhead lists a bank IBAN (DE16 4505 0001 0002 0005 00) even though this letter does not request any payment; it is a formally valid German IBAN but should not be used to pay anything unless a separate invoice or fee notice from the city explicitly asks for it.

No Widerspruch (objection) procedure is available for this decision per the letter itself ('ein Widerspruchsverfahren findet nicht statt'); only a direct Klage (lawsuit) at the Verwaltungsgericht Musterarnsberg is possible within the stated one-month period.
